commits.message:
refactor: merge jenkins-jobs/templates into roles/jenkins/templates

Moved job_*.xml.j2 templates into the role and updated src path.
Removed now-empty jenkins-jobs directory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: remove jenkins-jobs unused files and update README

- Removed deploy.py, requirements.txt, docker-compose.test.yml, scripts/
- Removed deploy_*.sh.j2 templates (managed by roles/jenkins instead)
- Removed jobs.yml and README.md (only used by deploy.py)
- Updated README with correct --limit hosts and available tags per role

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: update LFS tracking paths for binary files moved to files/

Changed from roles/*/files/ paths to files/ after directory restructure.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add HTTP health check and journalctl log output in deploy_app.sh

After systemctl restart, poll /api/swagger-ui/index.html (max 30 retries, 3s interval).
Print journalctl -n 100 output to Jenkins console on every deploy regardless of result.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor: move grafana/loki/promtail binary files to top-level files/

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: migrate agents to langchain.agents.create_agent and fix test mocking

- Replace deprecated create_react_agent with langchain.agents.create_agent in all 6 agents
- Add get_llm_no_think() for supervisor structured output (thinking disabled via extra_body)
- Fix test_agents.py: replace @respx.mock with unittest.mock.patch on httpx directly
  (respx intercepts openai SDK's httpx calls, returning empty response for unmatched routes)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test: isolate tests from external services and remove sensitive data exposure
